name: How long does a typical tub-to-shower conversion project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical tub-to-shower conversion project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical tub-to-shower conversion project duration can vary based on its complexity and the extent of customization. Simple conversions might take a few days to a week, while more extensive remodels involving significant plumbing relocation, custom tile work, or structural adjustments could take longer. As part of our commitment to a high-touch homeowner experience, AKN Design Group provides scheduling transparency and a clear project timeline from the outset, allowing you to plan effectively. Our managed process minimizes disruption while maintaining craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by complexity; simple conversions take days to a week, while extensive remodels may take longer.
